product_one_liner.value: Qubrid AI provides a unified GPU-cloud and AI inference platform—GPU compute, workload orchestration, and serverless APIs for open models—for developers, researchers, and enterprises.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes the unified infrastructure platform; the site describes its audience and GPU and inference offerings.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists model and GPU pricing.

named_customers.notes: The cited case study identifies CBIT. No second customer name was found; do not count NVIDIA, which appears as a technology/partner reference.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company information gives an 18-person employee count.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists McLean, Virginia, United States as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is largely model updates, API/developer guides, benchmarks, and product content; it does not demonstrate at least two posts by engineers explaining how Qubrid builds its own product or infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: Public docs include a Quickstart and additional platform, API, serverless model, and GPU documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A current Full Stack AI Engineer posting is an AI-titled role.

model_provider.notes: Public materials reviewed describe supported open models and self-hosted models but do not identify an underlying AI model or provider that Qubrid itself uses.

compliance_certs.notes: The hosting page references SOC Type 2/compliant infrastructure. It does not establish an independently held company certification; the listed claim is SOC 2 only.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports that Qubrid has not raised any funding rounds; Crunchbase search profile did not disclose any round data.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports no rounds, so no round was announced in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page/job listings were reviewed; available listed roles did not include SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive. The only verified current listings surfaced were technical roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index includes launch-related product/model posts dated September 1 and September 3, 2026, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The CEO profile identifies Pranay Prakash as founder/CEO from April 2024; no verified C-level or VP join/departure within the 12-month window was found. The full currently available team information does not establish a recent change.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Readable public documentation and available job postings reviewed did not name any CRM or sales/marketing system.
